Unrest among The Chinese staff of The
Chinese Government Radio Administration,
Sassoon House, Jinkee Road.

At 12.55 p.m. 22/9/37, a telephone message was
received from Mr. T.C. Loo(盧新園), Chief Engineer, The
Chinese Government Radio Administration, Sassoon House,
Jinkee Road, requesting the service of a foreign
detective in connection with unrest among members of
the Chinese staff.

In response to this message C.D.R. 179 and the
undersigned interviewed Mr. Loo, and learned the
following:- On the 21/9/37, fifty messengers employed
by the Administration demanded an advance of $10 from
next month's wages. The management refused to comply
with this demand, but agreed to grant an advance of
half this amount.

During the course of this morning Mr. Lee received
information to the effect that the messengers were
contemplating a strike, and had also threatened to
retain possession of bicycles supplied them by the
Administration.

Mr. Lee requested that a number of Chinese Police
be supplied to protect the premises and prevent the
bicycles being removed, if the messengers did come out

静安寺路沙逊大厦中国政府无线电管理处华籍职员发生骚动。

1937年9月22日下午12时55分，接获静安寺路沙逊大厦中国政府无线电管理处总工程师盧新園（T.C. Loo）先生电话，称该处华籍职员发生骚动，请求派遣一名外籍侦探协助处理。

针对此消息，刑事侦缉处第179号警员（C.D.R. 179）与本人会见了卢先生，获悉以下情况：1937年9月21日，该处雇用的五十名信差要求预支下月薪水十元。管理层拒绝满足此项要求，但同意预支该金额的一半。

今天上午期间，卢先生收到消息，称信差们正酝酿罢工，并威胁要扣留管理处配发给他们的自行车。

卢先生请求派遣若干名华捕保护办公场所，并在信差确实罢工时防止自行车被搬走。

At 12.55 p.m. 22-9-37, a telephone message was
received from Mr. T.C. Loo 陸德隆, Chief Engineer, The

detective in connection with unrest among members of the
Chinese staff.

In response to this message C.D.S.179 and the
undersigned interviewed Mr. Loo, and learned the
following:- On the 21-9-37, fifty messengers employed
by the Administration demanded an advance of $10 from
next month's wages. The management refused to comply
with this demand, but agreed to grant an advance of
half this amount.

During the course of this morning Mr. Loo received
information to the effect that the messengers were
contemplating a strike, and had also threatened to
retain possession of bicycles supplied them by the

Illegal Detention of the Manager of the Kwang
Hwa Petroleum Co., by Company's employees.
At 10a.m. 21-9-37, a meeting of the employees
of the Kwang Hwa Petroleum Company was held at the
Provisional Offices of the company at 854/6 Avenue Foch,
at which the general manager of the company, Mr. Ching
Yih Mung (程易門), informed them that the board
of directors had reconsidered the questioned of compensa-
tion of discharged employees and offerred them two
alternatives as follows:
(1) Those satisfied with three months' pay in lieu of
notice, may receive the money at once and leave the
service.
S.
(2) Those not satisfied with above compensation may
D3C remain in the service on half-pay which will be issued
from a "sinking fund," until the same is exhausted, after
2219 which the company will be under no obligation to the
employees.
The "sinking fund" is to be composed of the sum
equal to three months' pay of employees agreeing to these
terms, plus gross profits of the company for the month
of September 1937 (estimated to be approximately $6,000.),
plus 50% of the profits received by company after October
1st. 1937.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Illegal Detention of the Manager of the
Kwang Hwa Petroleum Co. by company's employees.

At 4p.m. 16-9-37, Wang Liang Ti ( 王良梯 ), one
of the directors of the Kwang Hwa Petroleum Co., came
to the Station and reported that Mr. Ching Yih Nyng ( 程
易門 ), general manager of the above company and six
directors have been detained by their employees at the
provisional offices of the company at Nos. 854-6 Avenue
Foch, since 10a.m. even date and not allowed to com-
municate with any one.

The undersigned accompanied by D.S.I. T'ang Tsu
Hung, C.D.S. 8 and C.D.C. 340 immediately attended and
ascertained that at 10a.m. even date, Mr. Ching Yih
Hung and six directors, had arrived at the company's
offices at the above address where all the employees
were gathered and informed, that owing to the present
state of hostilities it had been decided by the board
of directors to suspend the business and discharge
the staff. Every employee was to receive three months
pay.

The employees (mostly indoor staff) refused to
accept the compensation and demanded that six months'
pay and an allowance of $100.00 be issued to each
discharged man. This was based on a precedent which
had taken place in March, 1936 when the company was

光华石油公司经理被该公司职员非法拘禁。

1937年9月16日下午4时，光华石油公司董事之一王良梯（Wang Liang Ti）来到捕房报案，称上述公司总经理程易門（Ching Yih Nyng）先生及六名董事自当日上午10时起，被其职员拘禁在福煦路854-6号的公司临时办事处内，且不被允许与任何人联系。

本人会同高级侦探督察唐祖洪（T'ang Tsu Hung）、刑事侦缉处第8号警员（C.D.S. 8）及刑事侦缉处第340号警员（C.D.C. 340）立即前往现场，查明当日上午10时，程易洪（Ching Yih Hung）先生及六名董事抵达上述地址的公司办公室，当时所有员工聚集于此，被告知鉴于目前的战事状态，董事会决定暂停营业并解雇全体员工。每位员工将获得三个月的薪水。

员工（大多为内勤人员）拒绝接受该赔偿，并要求向每名被解雇者发放六个月薪水及100.00美元的津贴。这一要求是基于1936年3月发生的一个先例，当时公司

当时，留任员工要求得到某种保证，确保他们不会以不同的条件被解雇，董事会遂向全体员工发布了一封信，声明若在解雇情况下，所有员工将获得类似的赔偿。
经理解释说，1936年员工因重组而被解雇，而公司当时仍在继续经营；而目前公司因战事被迫暂停营业，无力支付所有员工（约60人）所要求的赔偿。
由于他们的要求未被接受，员工通过其领导人吴景清（Wu Kying Tsing）、张美衍（Tsang Mei Den）、孙新之（Sung Sing Ts）、潘家骆（Phan Chai Lou）和吴逸超（Woo Yih Sian），阻止程易洪先生及其他董事离开办公场所或与任何人联系。

At 11.06 a.m. 15/9/37 Warder Butler of the
S.M. Gaol telephoned the station requesting that
Police be sent to the Park Hotel 170 Nanking Road
to quell a riot.

D.I. Reddy, S.I. Harvey, D.S.I. Tung Chao
Ping and detectives proceeded to the Park Hotel
and after reinforcements had been obtained, they
being brought there by Inspt. Palmer, the party
brought to the station 36 members of the Park
Hotel kitchen staff.

Enquiries at the hotel upon arrival by D.I.
Reddy, D.S.I. Tung Chao Ping and C.D.S.309
ascertained the following:-

On about 13/9/37 Lieu Sou Lieu (盧壽祿)
one of the directors of the Park Hotel decided
together with Mr. Max Schilder, the manager, that
owing to depression a staff cut would have to be
made. The staff were informed but the kitchen
staff could not come to an agreement as the manage-
ment had decided to cut them 50%. They requested
a 25% cut.

At 10.30 a.m. 15/9/37 the kitchen staff asked
Mr. Hinson, the Chef, to inform the director they
would accept a 25% cut only. He with the intent
of informing the director proceeded from the
kitchen to the 4th floor. Agitators among those
arrested followed him and in the ensuing
excitement chased the hotel barber whom they
mistook for the director to the 4th floor to
room 418. When on the 4th floor all

1937年9月15日上午11时06分，上海公共租界监狱狱警巴特勒（Butler）致电本分局，请求派遣警力前往南京路170号国际饭店（Park Hotel）平息骚乱。

警司雷迪（Reddy）、巡官哈维（Harvey）、副巡官董兆平（Tung Chao Ping）及侦探随即前往国际饭店。在帕尔默督察（Inspt. Palmer）带人增援后，一行人将国际饭店厨房的36名员工带至分局。

警司雷迪、副巡官董兆平及刑事侦缉处警员309号抵达酒店后进行查询，查明情况如下：

约在1937年9月13日，国际饭店董事之一卢寿祿（Lieu Sou Lieu）与经理马克斯·席尔德（Max Schilder）先生决定，因经济萧条，必须裁减员工。已通知全体员工，但厨房员工未能达成一致，因为管理层决定削减其薪资50%。他们要求只削减25%。

1937年9月15日上午10时30分，厨房员工请主厨辛森（Hinson）先生告知董事，他们仅接受25%的减薪。辛森意图向董事通报，遂从厨房前往四楼。被捕者中的煽动者尾随其后，并在随后的混乱中，将酒店理发师误认为董事，追至四楼418房间。当到达四楼时，所有

Mr. Wilson attempted to quieten them and one of the

When he did so the 6th accused entered the 2nd accused
to go and get a tin of alcohol and shouted "Set fire
to the building". The 2nd accused returned with the
tin of alcohol (exhibit) and was pouring it on the
floor outside of the Barbers Shop thinking the
director was in there, with the intention of firing it.
When Dallas seeing the danger of a serious fire, half
of the alcohol had been poured on the floor, attempted
to obtain the tin, the 1st to 14th accused immediately
assaulted him knocking him to the ground, cutting his
forehead and hand, making multiple bruises on his body
with their feet and fists damaging his hat and clothing
and a writing case. (See exhibits and doctor's
certificate) Butler returned from the telephone and
succeeded in rescuing and dragging the said constable
Dallas to some distance off the passage floor. At this

    They were persuaded to open the kitchen door by
Mr. Nilsson and were apprehended as stated above.

    At the station Dallan identified the 1st to 14th
accused as the persons who assaulted him and at the
hotel D.J.I. Tung Chao Ping ascertained that the 5th
accused sent the 3rd accused for the alcohol with the
intent of firing the building.

    Liao Sou Lien, the director, in an interview was
advised to dispense with the services of all the
arrested persons it being pointed out the danger of
further disturbances occurring. He stated 4 or 5 of the
accused had agitated the remainder and also stated
that the majority of them who had been employed at the
hotel for 3 years but were unwilling to accept the cut
caused by recent depression.

    Dallas pointed out the 11th accused and 12th
accused as the chief aggressors and agitators in the
assault upon him. The 1st to 10th accused have been
charged with Disturbing the Peace Cont. to Art. 266 of
the C.C.P. and the 1st to 14th accused have been charged
with Assault Cont. to Art. 277 of the C.C.P. The
accused will be arraigned before the S.S.D.M. Court on
10/6/37 when the Asst. will be requested to assist the

    经尼尔森（Nilsson）先生劝说，他们打开厨房门，并按上述情况被逮捕。

    在分局，达拉斯指认第1至14号被告为袭击他的人；在酒店，副巡官董兆平查明，第5号被告指使第3号被告去取酒精，意图纵火烧楼。

    董事廖寿连（Liao Sou Lien，音译，即前文之卢寿祿）在接受问询时，被告知应解雇所有被捕人员，并有人指出若不解雇可能发生进一步骚乱的危险。他表示，被告中有4或5人煽动了其余人，还表示他们中的大多数人已在酒店工作3年，但不愿接受因近期经济萧条导致的减薪。

    达拉斯指出，第11号和第12号被告是袭击他的主要攻击者和煽动者。第1至10号被告被控违反《刑事诉讼法》第266条扰乱治安罪，第1至14号被告被控违反《刑事诉讼法》第277条殴打罪。被告将于1937年6月10日出庭受审于特区地方法院（S.S.D.M. Court），届时将请求助理检察官协助处理
